status: Existing motion and paint revision preserved. Keyframes added through the Claude Code design and Codex review workflow.
reviewer: Codex motion-design review; no independent human motion director was engaged

icons.name: heart
icons.label: Heart
icons.currentCritique: The anchored tip, delayed lobes, squeeze, and release already form a clear organic beat. Light is quiet; the accepted Strong has a visible crown expansion. This is one of the few gestures with its own internal rhythm.
icons.lightDirection: Retain the short single beat.
icons.strongDirection: Retain accepted v4.1. Use its clear preparation and peak as a reference, not its deformation amounts for rigid objects.
icons.constructionAndTest: Preserve the approved contour and timings. Keep the notch open at Bold; do not add a second beat, sparkles, or a new favorite state.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: The heart gives one short acknowledgement beat and returns to its anchored resting pose.

icons.name: bell
icons.label: Bell
icons.currentCritique: The shell and delayed clapper have convincing cause and effect. The one-second Light ring is long for frequent interaction; Strong is already expressive and does not need a larger swing.
icons.lightDirection: Remove the smallest late correction and aim for a complete ring around 650–750 ms.
icons.strongDirection: Keep the broader shell swing and clapper delay. Give the main reversal a sharper change of speed, then reduce amplitude smoothly.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep both real pivots and constant shell geometry. The clapper must not cross the mouth. Compare the revised Light against the current ring at 24 px.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: The bell rings from its top mount while the clapper trails and settles.

icons.name: search
icons.label: Search
icons.currentCritique: The rigid lens is sound. Both profiles still read mainly as a left-right gesture; the return is almost as prominent as the search. Strong has useful travel and an inspection hold.
icons.lightDirection: Aim the lens, make one short scan, and ease into an inspection point. Keep recovery quieter than the scan.
icons.strongDirection: Use a short aim, faster scan, 60–80 ms inspection, and a soft shallow return. Rotation should follow the path tangent rather than read as a separate wobble.
icons.constructionAndTest: Lens and handle stay rigid. Keep the clear lens opening and current frame margins. No result tick or endless searching loop.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: The magnifier makes one short left-to-right sweep, then returns to its resting pose.

icons.name: star
icons.label: Star
icons.currentCritique: Strong makes a large turn then unwinds. It attracts attention, but its middle pose loses the familiar upright star and the return cancels the flourish. Light is a small generic tilt.
icons.lightDirection: Make one brisk 72-degree clockwise index into the same fivefold silhouette.
icons.strongDirection: Preload by only a few degrees, complete the same 72-degree index with a more distinct acceleration, and stop cleanly.
icons.constructionAndTest: Exploit true fivefold symmetry for an equal final drawing. Keep the star rigid; do not rotate 360 degrees or add sparkle particles. Check that the turn still reads as emphasis at 24 px.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: The five-point star advances exactly one point; Strong adds a brief preparation and a small detent settle.

icons.name: check
icons.label: Check
icons.currentCritique: The short arm leads the long arm and completion remains visible. Both profiles communicate a real result. Strong spends more time settling than this message needs.
icons.lightDirection: Keep direct stroke formation; make the check readable early.
icons.strongDirection: Keep the same confirmation, with the full mark established around 220–280 ms. Any finishing correction must not delay recognition.
icons.constructionAndTest: Preserve the fixed circle and corrected inner gap. Reset should retract the mark promptly without a celebratory bounce.
icons.statePolicy: Keep explicit pending/complete states and Reset. Real completion must be true before the check is shown.

implementation.intent: An explicit completion transition; the result remains until Reset is selected.

icons.name: sliders
icons.label: Sliders
icons.currentCritique: The moving handles and fixed rails are right. The two handles largely mirror one another, so Strong reads as a wider exercise rather than a deliberate adjustment.
icons.lightDirection: Move the leading handle to a clear detent, then make a small secondary adjustment.
icons.strongDirection: Use a coarse first adjustment, a short stop, then a finer second adjustment. Give the two controls different travel distances and stopping times.
icons.constructionAndTest: Rails must stay clipped around the moving rings. Review the handle openings at Bold and 24 px. Avoid synchronized mirrored travel.
icons.statePolicy: In a product, retain the requested values. The gallery can show an explicit adjustment and reset cycle.

implementation.intent: The top handle makes the coarse adjustment; the lower handle follows with a smaller fine correction before both return.

icons.name: lock
icons.label: Lock
icons.currentCritique: This already has an action, contact, and retained result. Strong body response follows the latch. It is a better model for realism than a whole-icon bounce.
icons.lightDirection: Retain the direct latch.
icons.strongDirection: Keep the deliberate approach, firm contact, and one small body response. Remove any extra correction if it weakens the locked hold.
icons.constructionAndTest: Shackle ends stop at the body surface. Unlock should release the shackle before opening; never expose internal caps or move the body before contact.
icons.statePolicy: Keep explicit open/locked states and Unlock; the product must not reopen just to make a loop.

implementation.intent: A connected padlock closes and retains its state; Unlock is an explicit reverse.

icons.name: folder
icons.label: Folder
icons.currentCritique: Lowering the front edge suggests an opening, but both profiles mainly change panel height. Strong enlarges that change without revealing what is inside.
icons.lightDirection: Open the front cover a little around its lower hinge, exposing a complete stationary back panel.
icons.strongDirection: Open farther; one simple sheet follows after the cover creates space, then settles behind it. Close in the opposite physical order.
icons.constructionAndTest: Draw the occluded back and sheet fully. Use flat vector occlusion and a fixed lower hinge, with no perspective camera. Check the upper panel junctions at peak.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: A complete front panel opens from its bottom hinge; one sheet follows with a short delay above the fixed back panel.

icons.name: download
icons.label: Download
icons.currentCritique: The arrow moves in the correct direction, but eases near the tray and floats back. Light and Strong have the same phrase; neither gives arrival much emphasis.
icons.lightDirection: Use a quick descent and decisive receiving stop above the tray.
icons.strongDirection: Give the arrival a clearer speed change; let the tray make one tiny response after arrival, then hold before the quiet recovery.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the arrow rigid and preserve its painted separation from the tray. The tray response must follow arrival, not run on the same pulse.
icons.statePolicy: This can acknowledge a control. Show a completed-download state only when the transfer actually completes.

implementation.intent: The arrow arrives at the tray and stops; the receiving tray responds after contact, then the preview clears.

icons.name: upload
icons.label: Upload
icons.currentCritique: It is a reversed Download gesture with a longer upward displacement. Symmetric easing makes the arrow feel lifted by a tween rather than launched.
icons.lightDirection: Start promptly and accelerate upward, with a short hold at the higher pose.
icons.strongDirection: Add a brief loading-down motion, then a faster upward release and a quieter reset after the hold.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the tray stationary. Use acceleration distinct from Download’s arriving stop; protect the top margin and arrowhead.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: A short downward preload leads an accelerating upward departure; the arrow stays at its advanced position until preview reset.

icons.name: copy
icons.label: Copy
icons.currentCritique: The sheet separation is meaningful, but both cards feel like rigid plates and the return immediately merges the result. Strong only increases the offset.
icons.lightDirection: Separate the front sheet with a crisp diagonal release and a short alignment stop.
icons.strongDirection: Lift one leading paper corner slightly, then carry the whole sheet to its offset; let the trailing corner catch up once.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep page thickness and corner radius stable. Fully author the back sheet where separation exposes it; no page-background patches.
icons.statePolicy: A copy result should be held. Any merge used to rearm the gallery is a separate demonstration phase.

implementation.intent: A leading corner lifts the duplicate sheet away from its source; the whole page follows and holds separated.

icons.name: trash
icons.label: Trash
icons.currentCritique: The hinged lid and contact response are useful. The repeated smooth open/close spacing makes the lid seem weightless, and the exposed mouth needs a deliberate construction.
icons.lightDirection: Use a quick small opening and a firmer closing contact.
icons.strongDirection: Open briskly, pause at the hinge limit, close with acceleration, then let the body respond once.
icons.constructionAndTest: Retain the hinge and lid-handle assembly. Draw a complete exposed mouth or deliberate cutaways. Do not introduce a bounce before contact.
icons.statePolicy: Opening the lid demonstrates the control; it must not claim that data has been deleted.

implementation.intent: The rigid lid opens quickly at its hinge, closes with gravity, and the complete bin rim receives a small contact response.

icons.name: edit
icons.label: Edit
icons.currentCritique: The pencil touches and travels, but the rule remains unchanged. The central proof of writing is missing; Strong adds travel without a visible written result.
icons.lightDirection: Let the tip reveal one short stroke exactly along its contact path, then lift.
icons.strongDirection: Write a longer stroke with one brief pen lift or direction change, then lift and settle. Keep the writing faster than the return.
icons.constructionAndTest: Drive the ink endpoint from the same tip trajectory. The ink must stop growing when the tip leaves the surface. Add no detached decorative scribble.
icons.statePolicy: Requires an authored writing result and separate preview reset. Do not animate the ink backward as if writing undoes itself.

implementation.intent: The pencil tip touches down, drives the growing ink endpoint exactly, then lifts; the written mark stays.

icons.name: send
icons.label: Send
icons.currentCritique: The plane advances and then comes back. Strong makes the return more visible, so the action can read as a tethered plane rather than a send.
icons.lightDirection: Use a brief directional launch and settle at an advanced pose.
icons.strongDirection: Show a short preparation, acceleration along the nose, and a small bank aligned to the flight path. End the send before the preview rearms.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep fold and silhouette rigid. No motion trail is needed. Treat the gallery’s return as staging, not part of the delivery action.
icons.statePolicy: Separate launch/result from showcase rearm. Do not show a delivered state until the host confirms it.

implementation.intent: The plane draws back briefly, then accelerates along its nose direction and stays advanced; a quiet separate reset rearms it.

icons.name: bookmark
icons.label: Bookmark
icons.currentCritique: The tail gathers upward while the top stays fixed. It reads as a shortening banner rather than placing a bookmark; Strong exposes the accordion-like construction.
icons.lightDirection: Seat the ribbon downward into a clear resting position.
icons.strongDirection: Let the tip catch briefly as the body seats, then resolve one small paper bend. Keep the upper part controlled rather than stretching the full ribbon.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the notch recognizable and the ribbon width stable. A single page-edge reference is allowed only if insertion is unclear at 24 px.
icons.statePolicy: A true save toggle needs retained saved/unsaved states. Do not show an automatic unsave as the recovery.

implementation.intent: The bookmark seats downward while its paper tail follows and relaxes; the saved position remains.

icons.name: refresh
icons.label: Refresh
icons.status: motion preserved; unbounded Duotone tint removed
icons.currentCritique: The clockwise turn communicates refresh and returns naturally through a full revolution. Strong’s extra radial separation is less useful than the rotation and can make the symbol feel loose.
icons.lightDirection: Retain one clean clockwise turn.
icons.strongDirection: Keep the two arrows on a stable orbit. Add a more distinct start and braking phase rather than spreading the assemblies apart.
icons.constructionAndTest: Arrowheads remain attached to their arcs. No reversing overshoot at the end of the turn.
icons.statePolicy: One turn can acknowledge refresh. Continuous activity must follow real loading state and stop when it ends.

implementation.intent: Two arrow assemblies turn clockwise once and settle.

icons.name: eye
icons.label: Eye
icons.currentCritique: Strong is a recognizable blink with a protected pupil. Light closes only partway and can read as a squint. The symmetrical close/open phase is less natural than a fast close and slower opening.
icons.lightDirection: Use a quick complete blink with a very short closed hold.
icons.strongDirection: Let the pupil glance a small distance, then make one full blink and a slower reopening. Keep the corners fixed.
icons.constructionAndTest: Clip the pupil by the aperture in every style; keep a visible closed-lid band. A glance must not detach the pupil or change its shape.
icons.statePolicy: This is an acknowledgement blink. Actual hidden/visible content needs a retained state, not an automatic reopen.

implementation.intent: Light makes one full fast blink. Strong glances briefly before the lids close; the pupil remains clipped inside the aperture.

icons.name: menu
icons.label: Menu
icons.currentCritique: The bars and X form a clear state pair. Strong’s spacing change and long transition spend too much time in a fan-like intermediate pose.
icons.lightDirection: Retract the middle bar while the outer bars meet and turn directly into the requested state.
icons.strongDirection: Give the outer bars a short ordered lead, then resolve the X or parallel bars without a long fan hold.
icons.constructionAndTest: Review both directions. Current menu/menu-strong files CLOSE; menu-open variants OPEN. Descriptions must follow the manifest states, not the word forward.
icons.statePolicy: Keep explicit collapsed/expanded states. Do not automatically close real navigation after the animation.

implementation.intent: The outer bars converge and rotate together while the middle bar clears early; the reverse restores the three-bar menu.

icons.name: home
icons.label: Home
icons.currentCritique: The door narrows to a vertical stroke, so opening can look like a width tween. Strong reveals more of this construction instead of a more believable entrance.
icons.lightDirection: Show a small hinge-led door opening, retaining a clear door leaf and stationary doorway.
icons.strongDirection: Unlatch, open to a readable angle, pause briefly, then close firmly with no house movement.
icons.constructionAndTest: Separate leaf and opening. Use a flat projected hinge construction; do not scale the entire doorway or change the house silhouette.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: A separate door leaf opens from its left hinge inside a fixed doorway; the wall does not change shape.

icons.name: calendar
icons.label: Calendar
icons.currentCritique: The day square slides across an otherwise empty field and returns. It reads like a slider more than a calendar, especially in Strong.
icons.lightDirection: Peel one calendar leaf from the top binding and settle on the next page.
icons.strongDirection: Turn the full leaf with a brief paper curve; the day mark moves with the page and the next leaf is exposed.
icons.constructionAndTest: Binding stays fixed. The page shape and day mark must remain related through occlusion. Avoid tiny date numerals or a busy grid.
icons.statePolicy: A date/page change requires an explicit result. In a product, the displayed date must remain the requested date.

implementation.intent: A complete date leaf turns over the binding line; its date mark stays on the paper and the next page is exposed.

icons.name: clock
icons.label: Clock
icons.currentCritique: The hands advance, pause, and run backward. Strong makes the time reversal clear. The hand relationship is authored as an accent rather than clock gearing.
icons.lightDirection: Advance one decisive forward minute-hand step with the related hour-hand movement.
icons.strongDirection: Show a longer forward advance with a clear final tick. Do not unwind as the action’s finish.
icons.constructionAndTest: For elapsed-time motion, use a 12:1 minute/hour angle ratio and a shared center. If the intended role is winding a timer, name and draw that different action.
icons.statePolicy: Use explicit time states or a clearly separate showcase reset. Do not suggest that elapsed time reverses.

implementation.intent: Both hands advance together in a true 12:1 ratio and retain the new time; preview reset is a separate action.

icons.name: camera
icons.label: Camera
icons.currentCritique: Button-before-lens is a good causal order. Shrinking a circular lens opening reads as zoom or a hole closing; Strong makes this ambiguity larger.
icons.lightDirection: Press the button and close/reopen a compact shutter once.
icons.strongDirection: Use button travel, a faster iris close, a short closed hold, then a slower reopen and button release.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the outer lens rigid. Test a simple 3–4-part flat shutter construction; retain a legible aperture at 24 px. No full-frame flash or extra rays.
icons.statePolicy: A shutter action can preview capture. Do not add a success mark before a photo is actually captured.

implementation.intent: The button presses before four iris facets close and reopen inside a rigid lens.

icons.name: image
icons.label: Image
icons.currentCritique: The hills change shape under a fixed sun. The landscape looks rubbery rather than like image content moving inside a frame. Strong amplifies the deformation.
icons.lightDirection: Pan the landscape as one rigid content group inside the frame.
icons.strongDirection: Swipe from one simple vector landscape to another, with deceleration into alignment. Keep each landscape internally fixed.
icons.constructionAndTest: Use a real vector clipping boundary. The sun travels with its own image, not independently above stretching hills. Keep the frame fixed.
icons.statePolicy: If showing an image change, retain the resulting image; repeat only as an explicit gallery demonstration.

implementation.intent: Landscape and sun pan together into a new crop inside a fixed image frame, then hold.

icons.name: mail
icons.label: Mail
icons.currentCritique: The triangular flap flattens toward the seam but never establishes a complete open flap. Strong nearly removes its silhouette; there is no clear paper action behind it.
icons.lightDirection: Lift the flap around the seam into a clear open shape, then close.
icons.strongDirection: Open the flap first; let a single letter edge rise afterward, pause, reseat the letter, then close.
icons.constructionAndTest: Draw the full flap, envelope back, and letter before masking overlaps. A paper edge must not move through a still-closed flap.
icons.statePolicy: This demonstrates opening mail, not a claim that a message was sent or read.

implementation.intent: The full triangular flap opens above its seam, then a letter rises from the pocket; the letter returns before the flap closes.

icons.name: message
icons.label: Message
icons.currentCritique: Ordered dots are appropriate, but the long shared rise and hold make them float together. Strong changes height more than conversational rhythm.
icons.lightDirection: Use one quick left-to-right cadence with a short lift and a longer fall for each dot.
icons.strongDirection: Give the last dot a brief extra pause, then let the sequence settle. Keep the bubble still and avoid a second looping phrase.
icons.constructionAndTest: Dots keep their diameter and stay clear of the bubble edge. Short phase offsets must remain legible at 24 px.
icons.statePolicy: Typing motion belongs to actual typing state. A one-shot gallery preview must not imply a permanent live reply.

implementation.intent: A short typing cadence passes through three dots, one reply at a time, then all three return to rest.

icons.name: phone
icons.label: Phone
icons.currentCritique: A rigid handset lift is plausible, but the present up-and-back pulse lacks a pickup and placement moment. Strong mainly widens the same arc.
icons.lightDirection: Lead with the earpiece, lift briefly, then place the receiver with a clear stop.
icons.strongDirection: Use a quicker pickup, short listening hold, and a slower placement with one small settling correction.
icons.constructionAndTest: Preserve the rigid handset and its thick end contours. Do not add Bell’s repeated ringing swings or tiny exterior vibration marks.
icons.statePolicy: This can demonstrate answering. Actual active-call state must persist independently.

implementation.intent: The receiver lifts into a listening pose, pauses for the call, and returns with a slower placement.

icons.name: microphone
icons.label: Microphone
icons.currentCritique: The capsule tilts inside a stationary cradle. The mounting relationship is unclear, so Strong looks like a loose capsule rather than a positioned microphone.
icons.lightDirection: Tilt the capsule and cradle together around a visible stand joint.
icons.strongDirection: Make a deliberate positioning move, stop at the joint limit, then give one small clamp settle.
icons.constructionAndTest: Define the supported assembly and fixed stand before keyframing. Keep gaps consistent through the tilt; no rubber capsule.
icons.statePolicy: Do not add an audio meter or recording pulse unless the host is actually receiving or recording audio.

implementation.intent: Capsule and cradle tilt together at the stand joint, hold toward the speaker, then return as one assembly.

icons.name: volume
icons.label: Volume
icons.currentCritique: The arcs move outward and then return toward the speaker. Strong makes the backward signal travel more obvious. Sound emission needs a consistent outward direction.
icons.lightDirection: Send one short accent from the inner arc to the outer arc.
icons.strongDirection: Use a clearer outward phase delay and a longer outer-arc release. Keep the speaker still and avoid repeated fountains of arcs.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep a recognizable base symbol while the accent travels. Use trim/paint emphasis on separate arcs rather than translating sound backward.
icons.statePolicy: Show real loudness through retained signal levels; a pulse is an interaction or audio-activity treatment, not a volume value.

implementation.intent: Sound emphasis travels from the near arc to the far arc; the speaker and arc geometry stay fixed.

icons.name: wifi
icons.label: Wi-Fi
icons.currentCritique: Changing all radii gives an accordion effect. Neither profile clearly expresses signal acquisition or strength; Strong is simply a larger contraction.
icons.lightDirection: Establish the source and then emphasize the bands from inside outward.
icons.strongDirection: Use a distinct source response followed by ordered band acquisition and a short stable full-signal hold.
icons.constructionAndTest: Preserve the concentric geometry. Review both stroke and paint sequencing at Bold; do not crush the band gaps.
icons.statePolicy: Signal levels and connection completion must follow actual state. Gallery acquisition/reset is a separate demonstration.

implementation.intent: Signal acquires from the source outward, with each fixed band locking into a retained connected state.

icons.name: cloud
icons.label: Cloud
icons.currentCritique: The tall upper lobe inflates above a fixed base. Strong makes the cloud feel like a breathing organ, with little connection to either weather or cloud computing.
icons.lightDirection: For a weather/cloud illustration, use one quiet lateral drift with a small contour response.
icons.strongDirection: Send a single gust through the lobes while the whole cloud drifts slightly; the front responds before the trailing side.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep approximate visual area and avoid vertical inflation. If this icon means cloud storage instead, use a separately named transfer/sync variant rather than inventing weather behavior.
icons.statePolicy: The proposed default is a weather-style acknowledgement. Storage activity requires an explicit product role.

implementation.intent: A shallow wind drift passes through the cloud with a travelling contour response; its area stays nearly constant.

icons.name: sun
icons.label: Sun
icons.currentCritique: Separating the disc and rays is useful. The shared turn-and-return feels close to Settings, and all rays act together in both modes.
icons.lightDirection: Extend the rays outward in one brief wake-up, then settle.
icons.strongDirection: Pass the extension clockwise through the rays with a short phase offset while the disc remains calm.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the disc and ray thickness stable. The sequence should read as radiating light, not a gear or a loading spinner.
icons.statePolicy: Theme/brightness state must remain correct. The gesture does not temporarily change the actual theme.

implementation.intent: The rays open outward as a clockwise phase passes around a still disc, ending at the next symmetric ray position.

icons.name: moon
icons.label: Moon
icons.currentCritique: The crescent is stable and readable, but the short up-and-back arc can look like a generic rock. More energy is not automatically useful for a night symbol.
icons.lightDirection: Use a quiet upward drift with a slow landing and no rocking correction.
icons.strongDirection: Use a longer shallow arc and a clear still moment, with a slower release than Sun.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the crescent rigid and its tips safe. Contrast Moon’s calm timing with Sun’s radiating action instead of adding stars or another pulse.
icons.statePolicy: Keep the real dark/light theme state separate from the acknowledgement.

implementation.intent: The crescent follows one quiet, shallow arc with a long soft return and no extra wobble.

icons.name: location
icons.label: Location
icons.currentCritique: Anchoring the tip while changing the body height makes the pin look elastic. Strong magnifies the squeeze instead of showing placement.
icons.lightDirection: Move a rigid pin down to a fixed map point and stop.
icons.strongDirection: Give it a short approach, clear contact, and one tiny counter-lean about the landed tip.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the inner counter circular during travel. Only the post-contact response may use the tip as pivot. No repeated bouncing.
icons.statePolicy: Retain the located position. Do not automatically lift a successfully placed marker in a product.

implementation.intent: The rigid map pin lifts and lands on a fixed point, followed by one small contact response; its circular counter never squashes.

icons.name: compass
icons.label: Compass
icons.currentCritique: The fixed ring and rotating needle are appropriate. The held off-target pose interrupts the feeling of a needle finding north; Strong exposes that pause.
icons.lightDirection: Let the needle depart slightly, then resolve directly onto the bearing.
icons.strongDirection: Use one larger sweep and one small crossing correction, with no hold on the wrong bearing.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the ring fixed and the needle rigid at its center. Compare the speed through the center with the slower final approach.
icons.statePolicy: For navigation, settle on the real bearing. A north-return acknowledgement must not replace live heading data.

implementation.intent: The needle searches briefly, crosses the correct bearing once, then damps into a clear stable direction.

icons.name: link
icons.label: Link
icons.currentCritique: Both rigid loops remain connected, but mostly compress together. Strong can read as crowded overlap rather than a chain taking tension.
icons.lightDirection: Pull the leading loop a short distance, then let the other take up the slack.
icons.strongDirection: Make the slack-to-contact moment clearer; the second loop responds after the first reaches tension. Release in the reverse causal order.
icons.constructionAndTest: Preserve rigid loop geometry and the over/under opening. Do not separate the links or depend on a background mask.
icons.statePolicy: Link and unlink are different states. A tension acknowledgement must not imply a temporary unlink.

implementation.intent: The leading loop takes up slack; the second loop follows after tension reaches the join, and both remain interlocked.

icons.name: shield
icons.label: Shield
icons.currentCritique: The whole shield rocks around its point while the check rides along. There is no visible force or protection event, so Strong reads as an emblem wobble.
icons.lightDirection: Use a short controlled brace toward one side with a firm stop.
icons.strongDirection: Let one short incoming signal meet the shield edge and redirect around it while the shield makes a small rigid response.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the check stable as an existing state. Use at most one clear signal stroke; remove it if it makes the 24 px silhouette busy. No shattering or particles.
icons.statePolicy: A verified/protected result must already be true. Do not manufacture a successful check as decorative feedback.

implementation.intent: The shield braces at its lower point. Strong redirects one incoming signal at the edge while the attached check stays stable.

icons.name: cart
icons.label: Cart
icons.currentCritique: Rolling-wheel coupling is good, but the back-and-forth travel can look parked on a conveyor. Tiny wheel marks alone do not sell movement at 24 px.
icons.lightDirection: Roll forward with a definite braking stop.
icons.strongDirection: Start the wheels and basket as one assembly; add a small basket pitch only as braking occurs, then settle.
icons.constructionAndTest: Wheel angle must follow travel and wheel radius. Keep axles connected and the basket rigid. The main travel must carry the story even when wheel marks are tiny.
icons.statePolicy: Do not add an item or show checkout completion without the related product event.

implementation.intent: The wheels roll with travel, braking causes the basket to tip slightly afterward, and the cart rolls back to rest.

icons.name: settings
icons.label: Settings
icons.currentCritique: A gear turn fits the object. Turning and then unwinding feels less like a deliberate adjustment than an indexed stop; Strong mainly changes angle.
icons.lightDirection: Advance one 60-degree detent so the sixfold silhouette lands in its matching rest shape.
icons.strongDirection: Advance two distinct detents with a brief mechanical pause and clean final braking.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep teeth and center hole rigid. Use symmetry to close the loop naturally; no elastic teeth, wide overshoot, or continuous processing spin.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: The rigid gear advances into one or two deliberate detents without unwinding.

icons.name: user
icons.label: User
icons.currentCritique: The circular head moves sideways and down above still shoulders. Because a circle cannot show head rotation, Strong reads as lateral drift rather than a human nod.
icons.lightDirection: Make one small vertical nod, preserving the head-to-shoulder gap.
icons.strongDirection: Let the head lead a clearer nod; the shoulders answer a little later and settle after the head.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the head circular. Use very small shoulder movement, no rubber bust or detached head. Review the actual nod at 24 px before adding more amplitude.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: A vertical nod leads a small shoulder response; the round head keeps its shape.

icons.name: users
icons.label: Users
icons.currentCritique: The rear person moves up and right as a rigid pair, but that can look like withdrawing rather than joining. Strong increases the same ambiguous travel.
icons.lightDirection: Move the second profile slightly toward the group and settle.
icons.strongDirection: Let the second person enter the shared alignment first; the foreground person gives one small acknowledgement afterward.
icons.constructionAndTest: Move each person’s head and shoulders as a coherent assembly. Preserve the intended front/back occlusion and open head gaps.
icons.statePolicy: Joining a real group requires a retained membership state; a gallery greeting should not claim that someone was added.

implementation.intent: The second person steps into the group; the foreground person acknowledges the arrival with a delayed nod.

icons.name: key
icons.label: Key
icons.currentCritique: The complete key rotates around its bow and returns. The geometry is solid, but it reads like a hanging key swinging instead of a key being used.
icons.lightDirection: Lead with a short movement along the shaft, then a precise stop.
icons.strongDirection: Use a short insertion, a small controlled turn, and a separate release in the opposite order.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep bow, shaft, and teeth rigid. Treat the planar turn as a stylized key-use gesture; if it still reads as swinging, reduce the angle and emphasize axial travel.
icons.statePolicy: A key-use preview does not establish an unlocked or authorized state.

implementation.intent: The key inserts along its shaft, turns briefly at the inserted tip, then withdraws as one rigid object.

icons.name: scan
icons.label: Scan
icons.currentCritique: The bar travels inside useful brackets. Its smooth return makes a single scan look like a pendulum; Strong pauses in the scanned field before reversing.
icons.lightDirection: Make one directed pass at near-constant speed through the central field, easing only near the ends.
icons.strongDirection: Let the brackets make a brief focus adjustment, then run one longer pass and hold the scan’s end.
icons.constructionAndTest: The brackets must not clip the bar. Rearm the bar outside the meaningful scan phase while keeping the focus symbol visible.
icons.statePolicy: Scanning activity and successful recognition are separate. Do not add a found marker without an actual result.

implementation.intent: The brackets focus first, then one scan crosses at steady speed and stops at the lower edge.

icons.name: battery
icons.label: Battery
icons.currentCritique: The fill expands then drains immediately. Light resembles a small level twitch; Strong clearly suggests charge gained and lost in the same gesture.
icons.lightDirection: Advance the charge edge by one small level and retain it.
icons.strongDirection: Advance it in two clear steps, with a short charge pause before the final level.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the cell and terminal fixed. Preserve the current painted gap around the Solid charge region. Do not overshoot the actual level.
icons.statePolicy: Requires explicit old/new charge levels or a clearly staged charging demonstration; no automatic drain as a finish.

implementation.intent: Charge reaches a retained level in one smooth fill or two distinct charging increments.

icons.name: plug
icons.label: Plug
icons.currentCritique: The plug moves down toward its own cable. That is the opposite of seating the upward-facing prongs, so Strong exposes a wrong action direction.
icons.lightDirection: Seat the rigid plug upward along its prongs.
icons.strongDirection: Approach, reach contact, then let the cable bend settle after the body stops. A short socket edge may provide the needed contact reference.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the cable attached to the moving base and fix its remote endpoint. Draw any socket contact fully; do not compress the prongs into the cable.
icons.statePolicy: Connect and disconnect require separate retained states if used as an actual connection control.

implementation.intent: The plug seats upward along its prongs; a connected cable bends after the pull and relaxes on release.

icons.name: bluetooth
icons.label: Bluetooth
icons.currentCritique: The rune widens around its spine. It is a recognizable symbol, but treating it as rubber weakens its identity and does not explain wireless pairing.
icons.lightDirection: Keep the rune fixed and pass one short emphasis along its existing path.
icons.strongDirection: Let an upper-path signal lead a lower-path response, then settle the complete mark.
icons.constructionAndTest: Preserve the recognized geometry and crossings. Use separate trim/paint tracks, with no stretching or extra confetti dots.
icons.statePolicy: Pairing and connected status must follow the host. This sequence can demonstrate communication without inventing success.

implementation.intent: The Bluetooth rune keeps its geometry while an upper-path signal leads the lower response.

icons.name: monitor
icons.label: Monitor
icons.currentCritique: The screen tilts sideways about the stand. It is technically attached, but looks unstable and says little about using a display. Strong is a larger wobble.
icons.lightDirection: Wake one simple content pane inside a stationary screen.
icons.strongDirection: Expand a pane and arrange a second pane beside it, then settle the layout.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep bezel, stand, and foot rigid and still. Clip content inside the display; do not animate the hardware merely to fill time.
icons.statePolicy: Content is a wake/layout demonstration. Any real screen or app state remains under host control.

implementation.intent: A stationary display wakes its content, then the Strong layout resolves into two panels.

icons.name: smartphone
icons.label: Smartphone
icons.currentCritique: A lone square moves down and back inside the phone. It resembles a floating tile rather than scrolling content; Strong gives the float more room.
icons.lightDirection: Move a short stack of content rows with a small direct swipe.
icons.strongDirection: Use a brief drag, release into deceleration, and align the next row or card as it enters.
icons.constructionAndTest: Phone shell and speaker stay fixed. Content retains its own dimensions and is clipped by the screen. Avoid a rubber square or an unrelated notification bounce.
icons.statePolicy: Retain the resulting scroll position in a product. Gallery reset is separate from the user’s scroll.

implementation.intent: A clipped content stack scrolls inside a stationary phone; Strong flicks quickly and decelerates into the next item.

icons.name: laptop
icons.label: Laptop
icons.currentCritique: The screen becomes shorter above a separate base band. It approximates a fold, but the gap and changing silhouette make Strong look like a window shrinking.
icons.lightDirection: Use a clear hinge-led opening from a partially closed lid into the resting open display.
icons.strongDirection: Give the lid a deliberate opening arc and a short hinge settle at the open stop.
icons.constructionAndTest: Author a connected lower hinge and flat projected lid geometry. The apparent height change must follow the hinge angle; keep a consistent rim and no perspective camera.
icons.statePolicy: The gallery can stage close/open as separate phases. A real open state must not immediately close itself.

implementation.intent: A rigid lid opens from the continuous lower hinge and holds at its working angle; the base stays planted.

icons.name: printer
icons.label: Printer
icons.currentCritique: The output page grows while its top is fixed. Its printed line moves by half the feed distance. Strong looks like paper stretching out of the machine and retracting.
icons.lightDirection: Feed a fixed-size page through the output slot; the printed line travels with it.
icons.strongDirection: Feed in two controlled roller steps, with a short pause and one small trailing-paper response after the main advance.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep paper dimensions and ink-to-paper distances fixed. Move input paper consistently and use true vector occlusion at the slot. Validate masking/export support before authoring the full set.
icons.statePolicy: Hold the fed result. Returning the page is a separate preview rearm or explicit retract action, not the normal print finish.

implementation.intent: The rollers feed a fixed-size page; its printed line travels with the paper and the fed result holds.

icons.name: document
icons.label: Document
icons.currentCritique: The lines grow and shrink inside a fixed page. Strong makes them feel elastic instead of composed; no written result survives.
icons.lightDirection: Reveal one content line from left to right and retain it.
icons.strongDirection: Compose the first line, pause briefly like a pen lift, then compose the second at a different length and duration.
icons.constructionAndTest: Use trim or a true moving reveal boundary; do not scale a line about its middle. Keep page and fold fixed.
icons.statePolicy: Requires a composed result and an explicit reset for demonstrations. Do not erase text as the normal completion.

implementation.intent: Ink writes left to right, with the second line following the first; the completed document holds.

icons.name: clipboard
icons.label: Clipboard
icons.currentCritique: The clip becomes flatter while its lower edge stays fixed. Strong exposes the shape compression; the hardware does not act like a rigid clamp.
icons.lightDirection: Press a rigid clip lever around its hinge and release.
icons.strongDirection: Open the lever, seat a paper edge, then close the clip onto it with a clear contact stop.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep metal hardware dimensions stable. Separate board, paper, and lever; no paper travel through a closed clamp.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: A rigid top clip hinges open; Strong lets the paper seat beneath it before the clip closes.

icons.name: book
icons.label: Book
icons.currentCritique: The right page narrows toward the spine and widens again. Strong is a squeeze of one half of the book, not a page turn.
icons.lightDirection: Turn one leaf briskly across the spine with a small curve.
icons.strongDirection: Let the page lift at the free corner, bow through the middle, cross the spine, and settle onto the left page with a delayed trailing edge.
icons.constructionAndTest: Draw stationary underlying pages and one moving leaf. Keep the spine fixed, manage occlusion, and preserve compatible path topology. Anonymous pages can finish in the same silhouette without reversing time.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: One complete leaf bows across a fixed spine, exposes the next page, and settles on the left.

icons.name: credit-card
icons.label: Credit card
icons.currentCritique: A complete card slides sideways and comes back with no receiving reference. Strong increases travel but still reads as a generic nudge rather than a payment action.
icons.lightDirection: Move the card’s leading edge toward a compact fixed reader edge and stop.
icons.strongDirection: Approach along a shallow rigid arc, make a brief tap/seat, then withdraw after the contact pause.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the chip and stripe fixed on the card. Use one readable receiver reference only if it survives at 24 px; preserve the card as the main silhouette.
icons.statePolicy: A card gesture does not mean payment approved. Keep authorization and success feedback tied to real state.

implementation.intent: The whole card approaches a fixed reader, holds for the tap, and withdraws with its chip and stripe attached.

icons.name: wallet
icons.label: Wallet
icons.currentCritique: The clasped flap gets wider while its right edge stays fixed. It reads as elastic hardware. Strong exaggerates the expansion without an unfastening moment.
icons.lightDirection: Unfasten and pivot the flap around its actual attachment, keeping the clasp round.
icons.strongDirection: Open the flap, expose a single card edge, pause, reseat it, and fasten the flap in order.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep clasp and card rigid; allow only the leather hinge region to bend. Draw the revealed wallet opening and avoid painting under the clasp counter.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: The leather flap pivots from its right seam; its round clasp follows the hinge, Strong exposes and reseats one card edge, then the flap closes.

icons.name: gift
icons.label: Gift
icons.currentCritique: The exposed-cap correction now keeps the lid junctions clean in both modes. However, the box grows taller with the lid. It is a clean stretching gesture, not a believable opening; Strong makes that difference clear.
icons.lightDirection: Keep the box rigid; make a small lid lift over a fully drawn box rim, then close.
icons.strongDirection: Let the lid lead, the bow loops lag briefly, and the box remain planted. Hold the opening, close the lid, then let the bow finish once.
icons.constructionAndTest: Draw a complete exposed rim and terminate the center ribbon on it. Author lid, knot, and bow loops separately. Never reveal three loose line caps or use a background patch. The current fix stays until a new opening is built and reviewed.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: The rigid lid opens above a complete box rim; the attached bow follows and settles after contact.

icons.name: flag
icons.label: Flag
icons.currentCritique: The fixed pole is good. The current delayed upward displacement reads as a lifted free edge more than a wave travelling through cloth. Strong magnifies that lifted corner.
icons.lightDirection: Pass one small crest along the cloth from pole to free edge.
icons.strongDirection: Use a more visible crest and following trough, with the trailing edge resolving last.
icons.constructionAndTest: Advance wave phase in one direction and ease only its envelope. Keep top/bottom phase related and the hoist fixed; no backwards phase during the return.
icons.statePolicy: Keep a same-state interaction gesture. Product state remains independent.

implementation.intent: A crest and trough travel in one direction toward the free edge; the pole and cloth attachment stay fixed.

icons.name: chart
icons.label: Chart
icons.currentCritique: Bars grow in order, then shrink to the old values. Strong adds more growth but presents a temporary data change without a lasting result.
icons.lightDirection: Reveal the actual target bars from their baseline with a short reading-order stagger.
icons.strongDirection: Give each bar its own start and duration; longer bars take longer while earlier bars hold. End on the exact target values.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the common baseline and constant bar widths. No overshoot that falsifies the values, random heights, or endless breathing.
icons.statePolicy: Use explicit data states. A gallery build/reset may repeat, but actual charts must retain the real values.

implementation.intent: Three data bars rise from one baseline into staggered target values and retain the result without overshooting the data.

icons.name: filter
icons.label: Filter
icons.currentCritique: The lower tiers shorten and return. This hints at narrowing, but the broad common pulse makes it feel like another resize gesture.
icons.lightDirection: Narrow the middle tier, then settle the lower result into alignment.
icons.strongDirection: Use a clear source → subset → result cadence, with different move durations and a longer held output.
icons.constructionAndTest: Keep the top source tier stable and the lower tiers centered. Make the sequence distinct from handle travel in Sliders and baseline growth in Chart.
icons.statePolicy: Retain the actual filter selection. Clearing the filter is a separate action or gallery rearm, not the automatic result.

implementation.intent: The source remains full width while the middle subset and lower result narrow in order and hold.

icons.name: keyframes
icons.label: Keyframes
icons.designer: Claude Code; text proposals 01, 03, 04; proposal 02 timed out
icons.supervisor: Codex; geometry critique, implementation, native and visual checks
icons.lightDirection: A short playhead press stamps a key after the track clears.
icons.strongDirection: A 3-unit lift, brief hold, 5-unit press, and smooth release give the stamp a clearer cause.
icons.constructionAndTest: Rounded rigid diamonds; shared weights; clear counters; one opacity for the rail junction; separate Solid contour with buried caps.
icons.statePolicy: Keep the added key. Explicit 0.30-second preview reset.

implementation.intent: Cause: playhead press. Action: track clears. Response: a rigid diamond appears. Result: two keys remain; the preview resets separately.
